thread.title: Python/Pandas: Identify value count in a series and report. Also report "nan" counts

author: Salil Gangal
title: Python/Pandas: Identify value count in a series and report. Also report "nan" counts
text:
up vote 0 down vote favorite
In the following code I would like to count the number of times a particular value occurs in "Value" column and report it in column "Count_Non_Null". Similarly I will like to count how many times null (np.nan) appear and report in column "Count_Nulls".
In the example below the value "NFLX" appears once, "FB" appears 2 times, "MSFT" appears 3 times etc. Also np.nan appears 4 times.
The intent is to generate output similar to what's given in the image. Image of how the report is expected to appear import pandas as pd import numpy as np data={ 'Value': [ 'NFLX','FB','GOOG','VZ',np.nan,'MSFT','AMZN' ,np.nan,'MSFT',np.nan,'MSFT','INTC','AAPL' ,np.nan,'AMZN','FB' ] } df=pd.DataFrame(data,columns=['Value']) df['Count_Non_Null'] = False df['Count_Nulls'] = False print (df)
